release_notes: **Dhan charges under-booked**: the T+1 charges sweep booked partial totals as final (18 Sep trade ₹52.23 vs a true ₹126.42) because open positions never carried an entry date, so a later retry searched Dhan's date-scoped Trade History for the entry orders on the wrong day. The engine now stamps the entry date, and `charges.for_trade` returns nothing unless every order was priced. A failed lookup (expired token, 429) no longer burns one of the 3 "broker never settled" attempts. **Breeze charges booked ~40x too high**: `order_charges` read `total_transaction_cost` (taxes in paise, excluding brokerage) as rupees — ₹5,339 booked for a trade whose real charges were ₹133.39. It now reads `get_trade_list` (rupees, matched by order ID, partial fills summed) and raises on a failed lookup. **Kite `order_charges` swallowed every error** into an empty result; it now raises like Dhan and Breeze so retry paths can tell "failed" from "no price yet". Response shape confirmed against a live account (matched Dhan fills to the paisa on 3 of 4 orders). Reports trade log: the Exit column is now a fixed width and long exit labels clip with an ellipsis (full text in the tooltip) instead of stretching the table. **Per-row charges Retry** on Reports: re-prices just the clicked row from its saved orders (`POST /api/charges_retry`) and reports the real outcome (resolved / pending / no orders / broker error) instead of re-running the global sweep. The daily sweep also retries past ledger rows that saved their orders. `tools/fix_ledger_charges_2026_09_19.py`: one-off, dry-run-by-default, backed-up correction of past Dhan/Breeze ledger rows, with Kite estimates behind `--include-kite`. Prod needs a full rebuild + reinstall for the code changes to take effect.
